comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Extraction maps user/assistant/system/summary records into chapter-1 Messages (text, thinking, tool calls, tool results), native uuid/parentUuid become provenance record_id/parent_record, cost-state/pr-link/custom-title park in session state, malformed and unknown records skipped with counters, and partial trailing lines are held back until the append completes. right_now_summary: Claude Code transcripts now extract normalized parts, preserve provenance, and skip malformed lines safely.
